title: extensions/instance-facts/0.1: who an instance serves, how it keeps data apart and the space it runs in (fabric-instance-facts/0.1, DEC-0173)
description: The value of the instance-facts extension key in a service's descriptor, its well-known document, or both. Every member and every field is optional, save that a present tenancy names its mode and a present space its kind; an absent one, and an empty access, declare nothing, never a default. Declared by the service, never verified; FAC-SEM-180 reads it against the descriptor's peer, placement and runner and the well-known document's dashboard sign-in. Whose instance it is stays the estate placement's context (DEC-0082 item 4), never a member here.

audience.description: Who the instance serves: its operator alone; others it is offered to (beside peer: the members of the organization its placement's context names and anyone a share grant or an organization's listing names, a colleague or a guest included; on a remote placement, an organization's members reaching its own surface with their own keys); or, on a remote placement only, anyone who reaches its origin's own surface. It describes and grants nothing (DEC-0173 IF-2).

entry.description: How its dashboard is entered: a host's login code, a sign-in of its own, or none. Where the well-known document declares surfaces.dashboard, its login decides host-signin against the other two; a dashboard that requires a host's login code reads host-signin for a service that declares any fact (DEC-0173 IF-2, IF-5).

mode.description: single: one tenant, the context the instance serves and no other's data; per-organization: one of the copies a product itself runs one per organization; shared: one instance holding several tenants' data, kept apart by the instance, a remote placement's only (DEC-0173 IF-3).

kind.description: user: the counted OS account whose services directory declares it (DEC-0154); container or vm: on a local placement a guest on the computer behind a forwarder its own account owns, on a remote one a platform's container or virtual machine; system: a platform's service account, a remote placement's only (DEC-0173 IF-4).

account.description: An opaque label the installer or the operator assigns, never the OS account's name, a person's name, a path or a credential; on a local placement written only in the descriptor, never the well-known document (DEC-0173 IF-4, IF-5).
